<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Coin Hopper</title>
<style>html,body{margin:0;background:#111;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}</style>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.80.1/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<script>
const T = 32;
// Legend: # ground, c coin, E enemy, P player start, G goal flag
const LEVELS = [
  [ // level 1 (40 cols)
    "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "",
    " ".repeat(36) + "G",
    " ".repeat(25) + "cccc   ######",
    " ".repeat(10) + "ccc" + " ".repeat(12) + "####",
    " ".repeat(10) + "###",
    "  P" + " ".repeat(25) + "E",
    "#".repeat(17) + "   " + "#".repeat(20),
    "#".repeat(17) + "   " + "#".repeat(20),
  ],
  [ // level 2 (50 cols)
    "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "",
    " ".repeat(40) + "ccG",
    " ".repeat(40) + "#####",
    " ".repeat(20) + "ccccc",
    " ".repeat(20) + "#####   ##      ##",
    "  P" + " ".repeat(10) + "cc" + " ".repeat(23) + "E",
    "#".repeat(12) + "   " + "#".repeat(12) + "    " + "#".repeat(19),
    "#".repeat(12) + "   " + "#".repeat(12) + "    " + "#".repeat(19),
  ],
];

class Game extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Game'); }
  init(d) { this.level = d.level || 0; if (this.level === 0) this.registry.set('coins', 0); }
  create() {
    this.makeTextures();
    const rows = LEVELS[this.level];
    const w = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length)) * T, h = rows.length * T;
    this.physics.world.setBounds(0, 0, w, h, true, true, true, false);
    this.cameras.main.setBounds(0, 0, w, h).setBackgroundColor('#6ec6ff');
    this.walls = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    this.coins = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    this.flag = null; this.enemy = null; let start = [64, 300];
    rows.forEach((row, y) => [...row].forEach((ch, x) => {
      const px = x * T + T / 2, py = y * T + T / 2;
      if (ch === '#') this.walls.create(px, py, 'tile');
      else if (ch === 'c') this.coins.create(px, py, 'coin');
      else if (ch === 'G') this.flag = this.physics.add.staticImage(px, py, 'flag');
      else if (ch === 'P') start = [px, py];
      else if (ch === 'E') { this.enemy = this.physics.add.sprite(px, py, 'enemy'); this.enemy.minX = px - 96; this.enemy.maxX = px + 96; this.enemy.vx = 60; }
    }));
    this.h = h;
    this.player = this.physics.add.sprite(start[0], start[1], 'player').setCollideWorldBounds(true);
    this.player.body.setMaxVelocityY(700);
    this.physics.add.collider(this.player, this.walls);
    if (this.enemy) {
      this.physics.add.collider(this.enemy, this.walls);
      this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.enemy, (p, e) => {
        if (p.body.velocity.y > 0 && p.y < e.y - 8) { e.destroy(); this.enemy = null; p.setVelocityY(-300); }
        else this.scene.restart({ level: this.level });
      });
    }
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.coins, (p, c) => {
      c.destroy(); this.registry.inc ? 0 : 0;
      this.registry.set('coins', this.registry.get('coins') + 1); this.updateHud();
    });
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.flag, () => {
      if (this.level + 1 < LEVELS.length) this.scene.restart({ level: this.level + 1 });
      else this.scene.start('Win');
    });
    this.cameras.main.startFollow(this.player, true, 0.1, 0.1);
    this.keys = this.input.keyboard.addKeys({ left: 'LEFT', right: 'RIGHT', up: 'UP', a: 'A', d: 'D', w: 'W', space: 'SPACE' });
    this.jumps = 0;
    this.hud = this.add.text(12, 10, '', { fontSize: '20px', color: '#fff', stroke: '#000', strokeThickness: 4 }).setScrollFactor(0);
    this.updateHud();
  }
  updateHud() { this.hud.setText(`Level ${this.level + 1}/${LEVELS.length}   Coins: ${this.registry.get('coins')}   (arrows/WASD, jump twice!)`); }
  makeTextures() {
    if (this.textures.exists('tile')) return;
    const g = this.make.graphics({ add: false });
    const mk = (key, w, h, draw) => { g.clear(); draw(g); g.generateTexture(key, w, h); };
    mk('tile', T, T, g => { g.fillStyle(0x8b5a2b).fillRect(0, 0, T, T); g.fillStyle(0x4caf50).fillRect(0, 0, T, 8); });
    mk('coin', 20, 20, g => { g.fillStyle(0xffd700).fillCircle(10, 10, 9); g.fillStyle(0xffec8b).fillCircle(8, 8, 3); });
    mk('player', 24, 30, g => { g.fillStyle(0x2962ff).fillRect(0, 0, 24, 30); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(13, 6, 8, 8); g.fillStyle(0x000).fillRect(17, 8, 3, 4); });
    mk('enemy', 28, 28, g => { g.fillStyle(0xd32f2f).fillRect(0, 0, 28, 28); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(5, 6, 7, 7).fillRect(16, 6, 7, 7); g.fillStyle(0x000).fillRect(7, 8, 3, 3).fillRect(18, 8, 3, 3); });
    mk('flag', 32, 64, g => { g.fillStyle(0xeeeeee).fillRect(4, 0, 4, 64); g.fillStyle(0xff4081).fillTriangle(8, 2, 8, 24, 30, 13); });
  }
  update() {
    const p = this.player, k = this.keys;
    const left = k.left.isDown || k.a.isDown, right = k.right.isDown || k.d.isDown;
    p.setVelocityX(left ? -200 : right ? 200 : 0);
    if (left) p.setFlipX(true); else if (right) p.setFlipX(false);
    if (p.body.blocked.down) this.jumps = 0;
    const pressed = Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.up) || Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.w) || Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.space);
    if (pressed && this.jumps < 2) { p.setVelocityY(-420); this.jumps++; }
    const e = this.enemy;
    if (e && e.active) {
      if (e.x < e.minX || e.body.blocked.left) e.vx = 60;
      if (e.x > e.maxX || e.body.blocked.right) e.vx = -60;
      e.setVelocityX(e.vx);
    }
    if (p.y > this.h + 60) this.scene.restart({ level: this.level });
  }
}

class Win extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Win'); }
  create() {
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#1b5e20');
    const s = { fontSize: '48px', color: '#fff', align: 'center' };
    this.add.text(400, 170, 'YOU WIN!', s).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.add.text(400, 250, `Coins collected: ${this.registry.get('coins')}`, { ...s, fontSize: '28px' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.add.text(400, 320, 'Press SPACE to play again', { ...s, fontSize: '22px' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.input.keyboard.once('keydown-SPACE', () => this.scene.start('Game', { level: 0 }));
    this.input.once('pointerdown', () => this.scene.start('Game', { level: 0 }));
  }
}

new Phaser.Game({
  type: Phaser.AUTO, width: 800, height: 480, parent: document.body,
  physics: { default: 'arcade', arcade: { gravity: { y: 900 } } },
  scene: [Game, Win],
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<style>html,body{margin:0;background:#111;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}</style>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.80.1/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<script>
const T = 32;
// Legend: # ground, c coin, E enemy, P player start, G goal flag
const LEVELS = [
  [ // level 1 (40 cols)
    "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "",
    " ".repeat(36) + "G",
    " ".repeat(25) + "cccc   ######",
    " ".repeat(10) + "ccc" + " ".repeat(12) + "####",
    " ".repeat(10) + "###",
    "  P" + " ".repeat(25) + "E",
    "#".repeat(17) + "   " + "#".repeat(20),
    "#".repeat(17) + "   " + "#".repeat(20),
  ],
  [ // level 2 (50 cols)
    "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "",
    " ".repeat(40) + "ccG",
    " ".repeat(40) + "#####",
    " ".repeat(20) + "ccccc",
    " ".repeat(20) + "#####   ##      ##",
    "  P" + " ".repeat(10) + "cc" + " ".repeat(23) + "E",
    "#".repeat(12) + "   " + "#".repeat(12) + "    " + "#".repeat(19),
    "#".repeat(12) + "   " + "#".repeat(12) + "    " + "#".repeat(19),
  ],
];

class Game extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Game'); }
  init(d) { this.level = d.level || 0; if (this.level === 0) this.registry.set('coins', 0); }
  create() {
    this.makeTextures();
    const rows = LEVELS[this.level];
    const w = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length)) * T, h = rows.length * T;
    this.physics.world.setBounds(0, 0, w, h, true, true, true, false);
    this.cameras.main.setBounds(0, 0, w, h).setBackgroundColor('#6ec6ff');
    this.walls = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    this.coins = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    this.flag = null; this.enemy = null; let start = [64, 300];
    rows.forEach((row, y) => [...row].forEach((ch, x) => {
      const px = x * T + T / 2, py = y * T + T / 2;
      if (ch === '#') this.walls.create(px, py, 'tile');
      else if (ch === 'c') this.coins.create(px, py, 'coin');
      else if (ch === 'G') this.flag = this.physics.add.staticImage(px, py, 'flag');
      else if (ch === 'P') start = [px, py];
      else if (ch === 'E') { this.enemy = this.physics.add.sprite(px, py, 'enemy'); this.enemy.minX = px - 96; this.enemy.maxX = px + 96; this.enemy.vx = 60; }
    }));
    this.h = h;
    this.player = this.physics.add.sprite(start[0], start[1], 'player').setCollideWorldBounds(true);
    this.player.body.setMaxVelocityY(700);
    this.physics.add.collider(this.player, this.walls);
    if (this.enemy) {
      this.physics.add.collider(this.enemy, this.walls);
      this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.enemy, (p, e) => {
        if (p.body.velocity.y > 0 && p.y < e.y - 8) { e.destroy(); this.enemy = null; p.setVelocityY(-300); }
        else this.scene.restart({ level: this.level });
      });
    }
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.coins, (p, c) => {
      c.destroy(); this.registry.inc ? 0 : 0;
      this.registry.set('coins', this.registry.get('coins') + 1); this.updateHud();
    });
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.flag, () => {
      if (this.level + 1 < LEVELS.length) this.scene.restart({ level: this.level + 1 });
      else this.scene.start('Win');
    });
    this.cameras.main.startFollow(this.player, true, 0.1, 0.1);
    this.keys = this.input.keyboard.addKeys({ left: 'LEFT', right: 'RIGHT', up: 'UP', a: 'A', d: 'D', w: 'W', space: 'SPACE' });
    this.jumps = 0;
    this.hud = this.add.text(12, 10, '', { fontSize: '20px', color: '#fff', stroke: '#000', strokeThickness: 4 }).setScrollFactor(0);
    this.updateHud();
  }
  updateHud() { this.hud.setText(`Level ${this.level + 1}/${LEVELS.length}   Coins: ${this.registry.get('coins')}   (arrows/WASD, jump twice!)`); }
  makeTextures() {
    if (this.textures.exists('tile')) return;
    const g = this.make.graphics({ add: false });
    const mk = (key, w, h, draw) => { g.clear(); draw(g); g.generateTexture(key, w, h); };
    mk('tile', T, T, g => { g.fillStyle(0x8b5a2b).fillRect(0, 0, T, T); g.fillStyle(0x4caf50).fillRect(0, 0, T, 8); });
    mk('coin', 20, 20, g => { g.fillStyle(0xffd700).fillCircle(10, 10, 9); g.fillStyle(0xffec8b).fillCircle(8, 8, 3); });
    mk('player', 24, 30, g => { g.fillStyle(0x2962ff).fillRect(0, 0, 24, 30); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(13, 6, 8, 8); g.fillStyle(0x000).fillRect(17, 8, 3, 4); });
    mk('enemy', 28, 28, g => { g.fillStyle(0xd32f2f).fillRect(0, 0, 28, 28); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(5, 6, 7, 7).fillRect(16, 6, 7, 7); g.fillStyle(0x000).fillRect(7, 8, 3, 3).fillRect(18, 8, 3, 3); });
    mk('flag', 32, 64, g => { g.fillStyle(0xeeeeee).fillRect(4, 0, 4, 64); g.fillStyle(0xff4081).fillTriangle(8, 2, 8, 24, 30, 13); });
  }
  update() {
    const p = this.player, k = this.keys;
    const left = k.left.isDown || k.a.isDown, right = k.right.isDown || k.d.isDown;
    p.setVelocityX(left ? -200 : right ? 200 : 0);
    if (left) p.setFlipX(true); else if (right) p.setFlipX(false);
    if (p.body.blocked.down) this.jumps = 0;
    const pressed = Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.up) || Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.w) || Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.space);
    if (pressed && this.jumps < 2) { p.setVelocityY(-420); this.jumps++; }
    const e = this.enemy;
    if (e && e.active) {
      if (e.x < e.minX || e.body.blocked.left) e.vx = 60;
      if (e.x > e.maxX || e.body.blocked.right) e.vx = -60;
      e.setVelocityX(e.vx);
    }
    if (p.y > this.h + 60) this.scene.restart({ level: this.level });
  }
}

class Win extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Win'); }
  create() {
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#1b5e20');
    const s = { fontSize: '48px', color: '#fff', align: 'center' };
    this.add.text(400, 170, 'YOU WIN!', s).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.add.text(400, 250, `Coins collected: ${this.registry.get('coins')}`, { ...s, fontSize: '28px' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.add.text(400, 320, 'Press SPACE to play again', { ...s, fontSize: '22px' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.input.keyboard.once('keydown-SPACE', () => this.scene.start('Game', { level: 0 }));
    this.input.once('pointerdown', () => this.scene.start('Game', { level: 0 }));
  }
}

new Phaser.Game({
  type: Phaser.AUTO, width: 800, height: 480, parent: document.body,
  physics: { default: 'arcade', arcade: { gravity: { y: 900 } } },
  scene: [Game, Win],
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I wrote the game to `~/work/v2/index.html`, but I haven't run it. It needs a browser and an internet connection, because Phaser 3.80.1 loads from the jsDelivr CDN. Open the file directly or serve it with `python3 -m http.server`.

- **Controls:** arrows or WASD to move. Up, W or Space jumps, and you can jump a second time in mid-air.
- **Coins:** you collect them for a running total that carries across both levels.
- **Enemy:** one red enemy per level patrols back and forth. Landing on it from above kills it and bounces you. Touching it any other way restarts the level.
- **Levels:** both are ASCII maps at the top of the file, so they're easy to edit.
  - Level 1 has a short pit and a few platforms.
  - Level 2 is longer, with two pits and a stepped climb to the goal.
- **Goal and win screen:** reaching the pink flag takes you to the next level, and the second flag shows the win screen with your coin count. Space or a click restarts from level 1.
- **Falling:** falling into a pit restarts the current level.

All the graphics are generated in code, so there are no asset files.

I wrote the level layouts by hand without playing them, so the jump distances and the platform steps may need tuning once you try it.
